# Wan-Video Pilot (`wan-pilot`)
> Production preflight diagnostics, analytical VRAM budgeting, ComfyUI/CLI compiler, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for Alibaba Wan-Video models (Wan2.1 & Wan2.2 MoE).

## Developer & Research Fast Links
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/wan-pilot
- Documentation: https://engineerabdullahbinzafar.github.io/wan-pilot/
- WebMCP Actions: https://engineerabdullahbinzafar.github.io/wan-pilot/mcp-actions.json
- Agent Guide: https://engineerabdullahbinzafar.github.io/wan-pilot/AGENTS.md

## High-Impact Community Gaps Solved
1. **MoE Swapping OOM Elimination**: Prevents the 53.6GB concurrent allocation crash on 24GB GPUs via sequential expert offloading at boundary timestep t_moe.
2. **Attention Doctor & Windows Fallback**: Seamless fallback to PyTorch SDPA when FlashAttention-2 compilation fails under MSVC.
3. **EXIF Transposition (Wan2.2 #415)**: Auto-transposes orientation tags (1-8) and ensures 16-pixel spatial divisibility.
4. **Resilient Video Encoding (Wan2.2 #416)**: Multi-tier cascade (NVENC -> libx264 -> libopenh264 -> frame dump) with post-write verification.
5. **DiT Dtype Trap (Wan-Animate-2 #5)**: Enforces context-guarded bfloat16 to prevent meta-device fp32 regressions.
6. **Agentic Tooling**: stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 FastMCP server exposing 5 tools for autonomous developer agents.

## Quick CLI Usage
```bash
pip install wan-pilot
wan-pilot preflight --model wan2.2_moe_14b --resolution 720p
wan-pilot estimate --model wan2.2_moe_14b --resolution 720p --precision fp8
wan-pilot compile --prompt "A cinematic drone shot over misty mountains" --target cli_bash
wan-pilot ui
```
